nodes.label: Critical Architecture: Context-Aware Processing
nodes.rationale: Never filter artifacts before the augmentation loop (kills context); never duplicate this logic in individual processors; never remove heading/info_list/interface_list from PromptBuilder templates.

nodes.label: Critical Architecture: Hybrid Vision Strategy
nodes.rationale: Per-requirement model selection: requirements with images use llama3.2-vision:11b, text-only requirements use llama3.1:8b, selected via ConfigManager.get_model_for_requirement() so model choice is never hardcoded in processors.

nodes.label: Critical Architecture: Canonical Test-Case Schema
nodes.rationale: Comparing action/data fields the active template does not produce made every pair look ~identical and silently deleted legitimate test cases (2026-07-05 review); validation must be stamped before dedup runs since dedup's keep-strategy reads the validation flag.

nodes.label: Critical Architecture: Excel Formatter
nodes.rationale: Exactly 16 columns with fixed names (Feature Group at col 13, LinkTest not Tests at col 16) required so TestCaseFormatter and StreamingTestCaseFormatter must be updated together.

nodes.label: Critical Architecture: REQIF Attribute Mapping
nodes.rationale: REQIFArtifactExtractor maps internal identifiers like _json2reqif_XXX to human-readable names like ReqIF.Text; bypassing this mapping causes 'no text content' errors.
